description: Synthetic, made up for a test. Request 0 to 199. The pinned genesis is the FLOP devnet genesis (DEVNET_GENESIS in src/status.ts); every event and block hash is made up. Clause numbers refer to RULES.md section 3.1. Blocks 0 to 99 have a complete chain on the pinned genesis. The only page for blocks 100 to 199 is on another genesis, 0xb2b2b2b2b2b2b2b2b2b2b2b2b2b2b2b2b2b2b2b2b2b2b2b2b2b2b2b2b2b2b2b2 (made up): its 3 events, one of them unfinalized, go to excluded_other_genesis, the page adds no coverage (clause 6), and reset_detected is set. Counts never mix geneses, so blocks 100 to 199 are a gap and the census is partial. Expected: complete false, status partial; covered 0 to 99; gaps 100 to 199; totals escrows_opened 1, escrows_released 1, escrows_refunded 0, channels_opened 0, channels_settled 0; pending_unfinalized 0; duplicates_dropped 0; excluded_other_genesis 3; malformed_dropped 0; by_account synthetic-alice (escrows_opened 1, escrows_released 1).
